listing.eventDescription: One Airbnb listing with its price for your dates and guests (row keys price_total, price_nightly, price_nightly_effective, currency, rating, reviews_count, is_superhost, url): $5 per 1,000 listings. Amenities, house rules, host and the price breakdown (includeDetails) ride on this row at no extra charge. Not charged: listings Airbnb cannot price for the dates, duplicates, unknown places, empty searches, status rows. Without dates every listing row counts, at its default displayed price. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd).

calendar_month.eventDescription: One month of day-by-day availability for one listing (available, check-in and check-out allowed, minimum and maximum nights per day): $2 per 1,000 months, so a 12-month calendar is $0.024 per listing; the row also carries occupancy for the next 30, 90 and 365 nights. Not charged: calendarMonths 0 (the default), failed calendars, months beyond your spending limit (the row is trimmed to the months billed).

review.eventDescription: One guest review with rating, text, Airbnb's translation and original language, date, reviewer name and location, stay type and host reply: $3 per 1,000 reviews, up to maxReviewsPerListing per listing (default 0 = none, maximum 200). Not charged: listings with no reviews, failed review fetches. For a rating filter, every review of a listing or more than 200, use kestrel/airbnb-reviews-scraper.
